goal_level_requirements.title: Cash Withdrawal
goal_level_requirements.description: The system shall allow customers to withdraw cash from their account.

goal_level_requirements.title: Cash Deposit
goal_level_requirements.description: The system shall allow customers to deposit cash into their account.

goal_level_requirements.title: Balance Inquiry
goal_level_requirements.description: The system shall allow customers to check their account balance.

goal_level_requirements.title: PIN Change
goal_level_requirements.description: The system shall allow customers to change their account PIN.

goal_level_requirements.title: Mini Statement Generation
goal_level_requirements.description: The system shall allow customers to generate a mini statement of recent transactions.

interaction_level_requirements.description: The system shall validate the customer's PIN before processing cash withdrawal.
The system shall check if the account balance is sufficient for the requested withdrawal amount.
The system shall deduct the withdrawal amount from the customer's account balance.
The system shall dispense the requested cash amount to the customer.
The system shall validate the customer's PIN before processing cash deposit.
The system shall verify the deposited cash amount is a positive value.
The system shall add the deposited amount to the customer's account balance.
The system shall validate the customer's PIN before displaying account balance.
The system shall display the current account balance to the customer.
The system shall validate the customer's current PIN before allowing PIN change.
The system shall verify the new PIN and confirm new PIN match.
The system shall update the customer's PIN to the new value.
The system shall validate the customer's PIN before generating mini statement.
The system shall retrieve the most recent 5 transactions for the customer's account.
The system shall display the mini statement (transaction type + amount + date) to the customer.

non_functional_requirements.description: The system shall process all ATM transactions (withdrawal/deposit/balance check) within 2 seconds.
The system shall lock the customer's account after 3 consecutive incorrect PIN entries.
The system shall provide clear, text-based prompts for all customer interactions in English.
The system shall maintain transaction history and account balance data during runtime without data loss.
